captures.description: 'The Murder of the Vow refers to a theoretical, philosophical text written by Johannes Sigil that argues for the retrocausal abolition and structural illegality of the contract form. The document posits that traditional contracts essentially destroy personal vows by substituting living, reciprocal relationships with formalized enforcement and rigid obligations.' Expanded with Effective Act 7 CANONICAL named: The Death of Intent, The Bounded Future, Rejection of Formalization ('institutional contracts essentially taxidermy the living covenant into a rigid, lifeless obligation'). Medium 'THE MURDER OF THE VOW' (2 likes, 3 months ago) first organic. PAA: 'Murder of the vow contracts explained', 'Unbreakable vow Harry Potter'.
